'''March 2001 Phoenix tournament (24 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Phoenix, AZ on 24 March 2001. [[Patrick Hug]] won it. It is known from Jared Arthur's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1944">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-phoenix-3-24-2001d1944/ phoenix-3-24-2001], DeckTech (Jared "Don_Yoda" Arthur, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-phoenix-3-24-2001d1944/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Patrick Hug]]
